method: Curated, verified primary-source research. Bull/bear text is an inference from cited facts, not company guidance or investment advice. Research snapshot is separate from the April inbox replay.

dossiers.snapshot: Technology services and consulting. Better profitability and cash conversion coexist with shrinking IT-services revenue.

sources.title: Wipro Integrated Annual Report 2024–25
sources.dateNote: Reporting year ended 2025-03-31; exact publication date not verified.
sources.section: Year at a glance, printed pages 26–27
sources.excerpt: Operating Cash flow by Net Income
claims: Annual report rounds FY25 operating cash flow/net income to 128%.

sources.title: Wipro Q4 FY25 earnings-call transcript, filed 17 April 2025
sources.pageNote: PDF page 4: FY25 revenue/margin; PDF pages 6–7: Q1 FY26 guidance; page 9: booking conversion.
sources.excerpt: For the full year IT Services revenues were $10.51 billion reflecting year-on-year degrowth of 2.3%.
claims: Q1 FY26 guidance was a sequential constant-currency decline of 1.5–3.5%.
Management said deal ramp-up timing and existing-project ramp-downs affect revenue conversion.

facts.label: FY25 operating cash flow / net income

dossiers.bull: Inference: cash conversion above profits and stronger margins provide resilience during weak demand.
dossiers.bear: Inference: better bookings have not yet reversed revenue contraction; management guided another sequential decline.
dossiers.openQuestion: When will new contracts outweigh ramp-downs in existing projects?
dossiers.limitations: No four-quarter promise score; full-year guidance was not supplied. Do not treat operating margin as EBITDA margin.

dossiers.snapshot: Global technology services. Strong cash generation accompanies modest growth; management provides no numeric revenue or earnings guidance.

verificationNotes: Only official company documents support the dossiers; broker reports and news were excluded.
Source page values, when present, use one-based PDF page numbers. Printed page references are explicitly labelled in section.
Unknown publication dates remain null. A call date is not automatically a transcript publication date.
TCS annual cash conversion 100.7% differs from its Q4-only 125.1%; do not mix horizons.
Wipro annual-report OCF/net-income figure is rounded to128%; earnings datasheet reports128.2%. The dossier preserves the annual-report precision.
